correctness.rationale: The exact ball inequalities give anisotropic localization and convergence to beta-integrable scaled polar sections. For full contact rank an exact radial boundary formula yields a uniform power expansion; polar radial integration gives the second coefficient and strict sign. The simplex inertia specialization follows from barycentric Dirichlet moments. Numeric integrations agree in regular and nonregular cases; they are only supplemental spot checks.
